metadata.title: A new study of the variable star population in the Hercules globular cluster (M13; NGC 6205)

notes: No eligible stars. The only high-velocity object discussed, Gaia DR2 1328140781417544832, is described as a high-radial-velocity/runaway star passing near M13 (T:p17-b67, T:p17-b68, I:p18-b1), but the paper does not state that it is unbound from the Milky Way or establish an explicit Galactic-unbound criterion. The other stars are discussed as cluster variables/members or as membership contaminants, not as Galactic-unbound candidates.
